title: 第19章 青蛟第20章 禹王庙
content_zh:
战车之法，乃轩辕黄帝昔年为破蚩尤大军所创，流传后世，可聚兵卒血气以士气为纽带，连结化作军煞，威能莫测。
但那是陆战之法，在滔滔江河之上，任你军阵再精妙，也只是浮萍——黄帝他老人家和后人又没发明出战船，就是把战车搬到船上，那也仅仅只能聚拢一船之血气，天然为水所分割，难以成阵。
地境后期的蛟类，放在整个蜀地都是极为罕见的存在，一二十年也不见得能出一条。
这种层次的妖物，已经不是单纯靠人多就能堆死的了，哪怕有两名地境武士，那也只能配合军阵拖延，在岸上陈列兵马，抵挡其上岸。
“灌江口的兵力呢？”
“守军三千，但从我出发时，就已经死伤惨重。”
杨戬回答道。
祁澜闻言，没有再作声。
那水蛟还在蓄水，实力只会在随着水势增大的化蛟过程中，不断变强。
一旦水势积蓄到了某个临界点，这条蛟就会借着洪水之势，顺流而下，借山洪灵气与江河龙脉锤炼筋骨鳞甲，完成真正的走水化蛟。
届时沿途所过之处，尽成泽国。
……
……
一个时辰后，灌江口的轮廓出现在视野中。
但那已经不是祁澜记忆中繁华热闹的水陆码头了。
远远望去，灌江口外围的低矮建筑已经有大半泡在了水中，浑浊的江水漫过了外堤，在街道上形成了齐腰深的洪流。更远处的岷江江面上，水位比正常时节高出了一丈有余，浪涛翻涌，隐隐能看到江心处有一道巨大的黑影在水下游弋。
“那就是它。”杨戬指着江心。
祁澜的目光锁定了那道黑影，瞳孔微缩。
即便隔着这么远的距离，他也能感受到那股压迫感。那是属于地境后期妖物的凶戾气息，比他在玄泽遇到的那对鼍龙还要浓烈数倍。
“走，先去找郑言。”

一行人策马冲入灌江口内城。内堤还在，水没有漫进来，但到处都是慌乱奔走的百姓和维持秩序的兵丁。
内堤之上，一面蜀侯的旗帜在风雨中猎猎作响。旗下，一名身披铁甲、面容刚毅的中年将领正在指挥士卒加固堤防。他的铠甲上满是划痕和血迹，左肩的护甲已经碎裂了一大片，露出里面被布条紧紧缠裹的伤口。
“郑将军！”杨戬翻身下马，冲了过去。
郑言转过头来，看到杨戬身后的祁澜等人，紧绷的面容稍稍松弛了一分。
“长溪部的援军？”
“长溪世子祁澜，奉父命率部驰援。”祁澜翻身下马，拱手道，“这位是我叔父祁虎，长溪国亚卿司马。”
郑言上下打量了祁澜一眼，目光在他腰间的碧水铜剑上停留了一瞬。
“世子年少有为，早就有闻长溪世子是蜀地一流的武道俊才，今日一见，果然不凡，没想到竟然已经成就地境。”
“将军客气了，可否介绍一下当下的形势？”
郑言闻言，倒也没有多余的客套，直接道，“情况很不好。那条青蛟的实力是地境后期，而且它一直待在水里，我们根本没办法把它引上岸。每隔一段时间，它就会冲击外堤，扩大缺口，蓄积水势。照这个速度，最多再有半日，内堤也撑不住了。”
“其他援军呢？”
“宗明在东面堤段，带人堵缺口。”
郑言指了个方向，“崇山伯的别部司马常坤，比你们要早来一些，在西面布防。”
“副将钟直呢？”
content_en:
The chariot method was created by Emperor Xuanyuan in the past to defeat Chiyou's army. It was passed down to later generations. It can gather the blood and energy of the soldiers and use their morale as a link. The connection turns into a military evil with unpredictable power.
But that is the method of land warfare. On the surging rivers, no matter how sophisticated your military formation is, it is just duckweed - Huang Di and his descendants did not invent war ships. Even if they moved the war chariots to the ships, they could only gather a ship's worth of blood. They were naturally divided by water and difficult to form a formation.
Jiaos in the late stage of the realm are extremely rare in the entire Shu region, and there may not even be one in ten or twenty years.
Monsters of this level can no longer be killed by simply relying on the number of people. Even if there are two earth warriors, they can only cooperate with the military formation to delay and display soldiers and horses on the shore to prevent them from coming ashore.
"Where are the troops at Guanjiangkou?"
"There are three thousand defenders, but there have been heavy casualties since I set out."
Yang Jian replied.
Qi Lan didn't say anything after hearing this.
The water dragon is still storing water, and its strength will only continue to grow during the process of transforming into a water dragon as the water power increases.
Once the water reaches a certain critical point, the dragon will use the force of the flood to flow down the river, using the aura of the mountain torrent and the dragon veins of the river to temper its muscles, bones, scales, and complete the true transformation of the dragon through water.
By then, everything along the way will become Zeguo.
…
…
An hour later, the outline of Guanjiang Estuary appeared in the field of vision.
But that is no longer the bustling land and water dock in Qi Lan's memory.
Looking from a distance, most of the low-rise buildings outside Guanjiang Estuary were submerged in water. The turbid river water overflowed the outer embankment, forming a waist-deep torrent on the street. Further away, on the Minjiang River, the water level was more than ten feet higher than normal. The waves were rolling, and a huge black shadow could be faintly seen swimming in the middle of the river.
"That's it." Yang Jian pointed at Jiang Xin.
Qi Lan's eyes locked on the black figure, and his pupils shrank.
Even from such a long distance, he could feel the pressure. It was the ferocious aura belonging to monsters in the late stage of the Earth Realm, and it was several times stronger than the pair of dragons he encountered in Xuanze.
"Let's go and find Zheng Yan first."
A group of people rode their horses and rushed into the inner city of Guanjiangkou. The inner embankment is still there and the water has not flooded in, but there are people running around in panic and soldiers maintaining order everywhere.
On the inner embankment, a banner of the Lord of Shu was flapping in the wind and rain. Under the banner, a middle-aged general wearing iron armor and a resolute face was directing his soldiers to strengthen the embankment. His armor was covered with scratches and bloodstains, and a large piece of the armor on his left shoulder had been shattered, revealing the wound inside that was tightly wrapped with cloth strips.
"General Zheng!" Yang Jian got off his horse and rushed over.
Zheng Yan turned around and saw Qi Lan and others behind Yang Jian, and his tense face relaxed slightly.
"Reinforcements from the Changxi tribe?"
"Qi Lan, the Crown Prince of Changxi, was ordered by his father to lead his troops to help." Qi Lan turned over and dismounted, cupped his hands and said, "This is my uncle Qi Hu, Sima, the Yaqing of Changxi Kingdom."
Zheng Yan looked Qi Lan up and down, his eyes lingering on the blue water copper sword at his waist for a moment.
"The prince is young and promising. I have long heard that the prince of Changxi is a first-class martial arts talent in Shu. When I saw him today, he was indeed extraordinary. I didn't expect that he had already achieved greatness."
"General, you're welcome. Can you tell us about the current situation?"
When Zheng Yan heard this, he didn't have any extra courtesy and said directly, "The situation is very bad. The green dragon's strength is at the late stage of the Earth Realm, and it has been staying in the water. We have no way to lead it ashore. Every once in a while, it will hit the outer embankment, widen the gap, and accumulate water. At this rate, it will take at least half a day before the inner embankment can't hold on."
"Where are the other reinforcements?"
"Zong Ming is on the east side of the embankment, leading people to block the gap."
Zheng Yan pointed in the direction, "Sima Changkun, another subordinate of Uncle Chongshan, came earlier than you and set up defenses in the west."
"Where's Lieutenant General Zhong Zhi?"
